title.text: Learner version · log in → modules → slide player

title2.text: Facilitator & Admin versions · switch with the View menu

learner.text:
LEARNER (simple follow-along)
Log in → module selection → slide player. Swipe or arrow through slides; slides that call an activity show a cue that scrolls you down to it. Slides after the Bridge stay locked until it's submitted. 'Follow room' hands the slides to the facilitator.
Press Play on Log in; any code, e.g. DEMO-PILOT.

roles.text:
ROLES AND THE VIEW MENU
Learner: follow along, write, seal.
Facilitator: classes, assign work, people and roles, live sessions.
Admin: everything a facilitator can do, plus edit material and grant access.
The View menu (Facilitator / Learner / Admin) appears only for people granted facilitator or admin access; a learner never sees it.
